implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): there is no change board, so under CM-3(g) the owner is the change control element. POL-01 4.3 requires a risk assessment update, which also serves HSP-01, after any major change. POL-01 6.1 keeps a vendor list with the date each service's terms were last reviewed. From 2026-10-05, BOLs use a locked product description sheet and no AI-drafted hazmat descriptions. Gap: POL-01 has no change log for account or device settings.

The BIA (P05), POL-01 section 11, HSP-01 section 6 (hold releases if the owner cannot be reached), and the P08 runbook form the contingency plan. Gaps: the coverage arrangement with another distributor and the sealed recovery codes are not in place (due 2026-12-31).

No employees. HSP-01 section 4.1 sets the applicant identity and history check to use before any hire with access to shipment releases (172.802(a)(1)).

evidence: P09 vendor review; ERI provider confirmation 2026-09-14

provider_if_inherited: SaaS vendors; device OS vendors; ISP
implementation_statement: SaaS vendors patch their services. Automatic OS and browser updates are on for the laptop and phone. Gap: nobody knows whether the ISP router receives firmware updates.
The operating system's built-in antivirus runs real-time scanning with automatic updates. Owner responsibility: keep it on and act on alerts.
The email suite filters spam and known phishing. It did not stop the 2026-06-17 lookalike-domain message, which is why HSP-01 adds call-back verification instead of relying on filtering.

BOL copies are kept, but without a rule or a check that the acceptance date is recorded. Gap: driver license numbers are kept indefinitely. POL-01 section 8 sets 2 years for BOLs (172.201(e)), 3 years for registration records (107.620(a)), training records while employed plus 90 days (172.704(d)), and 90 days for driver identity data.
